notes.title: The ANZ Indie Showcase!
notes.content:
[p]The team is very proud and excited to be part of the ANZ indie Showcase Sept 5th 7pm AEST!

We'll also be showing off a new trailer with the event, so stay tuned for more chaos to ensue![/p]

notes.title: Galaxy Fest revealed some important tweaks!
notes.content: [p]Over the weekend we took Odd Jobs out for another spin. This time under the spotlight was the star system of each level difficulty and how well the new tutorial faired.[/p][p][/p][p]The feedback was incredibly encouraging with lots of laughs and funny moments! We also managed to identify a potential tardiness in the movement which we've since hopefully removed and kept things snappy and chaotic![/p][p][/p][p]We're super excited to see what else our The Lot Crew (TLC) group get up to in further development! Stay tuned right here for more udpates.[/p]

notes.title: Odd Jobs shines at 4 Ports!
notes.content:
[p]The weekend was a big milestone for Odd jobs first public appearance at a local Sydney event hosted by Fortress! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677268/aa39465d58437023dd9e542315027a40731b8a36.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
Seeing the laughs and smiles it brought to all the groups who had a go brings a new wave of motivation to myself and the team.[/p][p][/p][p]It was particularly encouraging to see players make use of the Ute vehicle and other type of trolleys![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates as development continues right here![/p]

notes.title: Welcome to The Lot Crew (TLC)
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to have a steam page and make our first announcement that Odd Jobs exists![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more details as we embark on this game dev journey together right here![/p][p][/p][p]Also don’t forget to visit our discord if you’d like to hang out![/p]
